reference: Mi-26 (izdeliye 90) cockpit: pilot (commander) left and co-pilot right side by side, each with a steam-gauge panel (AGB attitude, UShM heading, airspeed, altimeter, VVI, rotor-RPM and twin-engine power indicators), centre cyclic, collective on the left with the twist throttle, and the two D-136 engine control levers; flight engineer and navigator behind (not modelled). Turquoise Soviet interior as the original model; airforce-technology.com Mi-26 project page (crew layout), FAS Mi-26 page, model's own seat/window measurements
